source_evidence.behavior: ApplyRefund rejects Cancelled and Multi; computes no payment-collected predicate; requires amount positive and <= Total - RefundAmount; appends the supplied OrderRefund, increments RefundAmount, and sets Refunded on equality to Total. Pure aggregate mutation, with no ledger or I/O effect itself.

The route handler replays by refund-{RefundRequestId}; loads the order under SQL Server UPDLOCK/ROWLOCK/HOLDLOCK in a ReadCommitted transaction; authorizes orders_refund; caps request against order total remaining; verifies only the mapped source account's aggregate protected balance; creates the refund movement and child; calls ApplyRefund; saves order/refund/movement/audit together and commits. It does not check order.IsPaid, cash-on-delivery status, confirmed electronic leg, or order-specific collected amount before posting. Unique idempotency and same-order locking protect replay/concurrent over-refund, not payment entitlement.

Cash-on-delivery is Delivery + Cash + positive total; pending electronic legs are explicit claims. ComputeIsPaid returns false for cash-on-delivery/electronic-pending; DefersAllMoney confirms checkout intentionally posts no treasury money for these cases.

Checkout may deduct stock before settlement, but only creates sale movements and completes the financial journal when DefersAllMoney is false. This confirms deferred/uncollected states can exist without sale movement at checkout.

Electronic payment confirmation is the separate operation that locks the order, requires the aggregate pending-leg transition, marks IsPaid, and posts the sale movement/journal. It is counterevidence against treating a pending leg as collected; it does not gate RefundOrderHandler.

Order version is an application-managed concurrency token; OrderRefund idempotency key and treasury movement idempotency key have unique indexes. These constrain concurrency/replays, not collected-vs-refundable entitlement.
POST /api/orders/refund invokes RefundOrderHandler and maps domain failures to UnprocessableEntity and idempotency conflicts to Conflict.

counterevidence_and_scope.financial_controls_confirmed: Requires orders_refund permission or manager approval; source account must have sufficient aggregate protected balance; refund amount cannot exceed order total remaining; row lock, concurrency token and unique idempotency indexes address duplicate/concurrent posting.
